I built a fully functional bicycle using only PVC pipes to see if it’s actually possible.
In this video I test whether a DIY PVC bike can support weight, stay stable, and actually be ridden.

This project explores simple engineering, DIY design, and material limits — using only plastic pipes instead of metal.
